annotations.title: See what is waiting to be sent

description: Every message waiting in a number's send queue, soonest first. Messages to one person wait unless they reply to a message received in the last 24 hours. Known contacts still wait, and every batch message waits the full gap. Accepted messages are charged then released one at a time, 15–25 minutes apart by default, measured from the previous message's actual release. `scheduledAt` is an estimate. `paused` means the number is not connected; messages that have not left stay queued and resume with the configured spacing when it reconnects. `message.sent` arrives when one leaves. Free.

limit.description: How many to return, soonest first. Default 200.

numberId.description: Only this number's queue. Omit for every number on the account.
